Hemingray Glass Company, No. 17 and Patent 1893 Models
Aqua Blue and Clear, Vintage 19th to 20th Century
This collection features three vintage glass insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, once the world's largest manufacturer of glass insulators. These utilitarian pieces were originally designed to support telegraph and telephone wires, and are now highly sought after for their iconic industrial aesthetic and diverse color variations.
Pieces Included:
Insulator, Aqua Blue glass, marked "HEMINGRAY" and "PATENT MAY 2 1893," featuring sharp drip points on the base edge.
Insulator, Clear glass, marked "HEMINGRAY-17," featuring a smooth flared base with a textured grip ring.
Insulator, Clear glass, marked "HEMINGRAY-17," featuring a smooth flared base with a textured grip ring.
Condition:
The aqua blue insulator shows significant internal soot or carbon deposits and surface grime from authentic outdoor service. The clear insulators show minor surface wear and occasional internal bubbles characteristic of molded utility glass. No significant structural cracks are observed, though minor fleabites consistent with industrial usage may be present along the base edges.

description:
Fossil Fish Specimen
Natural Stone Matrix, Prehistoric Aquatic Life
Stone, Approximately 7 x 7 x 2 Inches
This genuine prehistoric fossilized fish specimen is preserved within a natural sedimentary stone matrix. Such fossils provide a fascinating look at ancient marine or freshwater ecosystems, showcasing the delicate preservation of biological structures over millions of years. This particular piece displays prominent anatomical features, making it an excellent educational tool or addition to a natural history collection.
Natural stone matrix containing a detailed fossil fish impression
Visible skeletal features including the spine, head, and fin structure
Compact nodule-style matrix suitable for display or study
Measurements: Approximately 7 inches long by 7 inches wide and 2 inches thick; Weight: 2.1 lbs
Condition:
The fossilized remains are well-defined within the surrounding stone. The matrix exhibits natural texture, fissures, and color variations consistent with genuine geological specimens. No evidence of artificial restoration or composite assembly. The perimeter and base of the stone are raw and unpolished as excavated. Includes plastic storage container with cotton padding.

description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray, Ohio Valley Glass Co. (O.V.G. Co.)
Aqua and Teal Green, Vintage
Collection of three vintage glass insulators originally utilized for telegraph and telephone line insulation. This lot features insulators from prominent American manufacturers, showcasing the industrial aqua and teal green glass common to early 20th-century utility production. These heavy pressed glass pieces are sought after for their historical industrial aesthetic and display appeal.
Pieces Included:
Insulator, Aqua, marked "O.V.G. CO." - features a large chip on the side and base
Insulator, Teal Green, marked "N 21" - internal vertical crack visible on the crown

Polished Geode Slice Slab
8.5" x 7.5" x 0.5"
Unsigned
This striking natural agate slice presents a sophisticated geological display, featuring a series of intricate, concentric bands in a palette of deep obsidian, warm brown, and translucent cream. The specimen has been expertly cut and polished on both faces to a high-gloss finish, revealing the complex mineral formations and internal structure characteristic of high-quality geodes. The center of the piece features an open druzy pocket where minute quartz crystals catch the light, providing a sparkling focal point.
Distinctive concentric banding showcasing natural mineral deposition layers
Polished on both sides to enhance color depth and crystalline clarity
Rough natural outer edge preserved for an authentic organic aesthetic
Substantial thickness at 0.5" providing stability for display
Condition:

description:
Cross
Classic Century Pen and Mechanical Pencil Set
Chrome and Gold-Tone Finish, Vintage
This vintage writing set from A.T. Cross features the slim, elegant profile of the Classic Century collection, a design icon since its introduction in 1946. The set includes a ballpoint pen in the "Medalist" finish-composed of brushed chrome with 23KT gold-plated accents-paired with a polished chrome mechanical pencil. Renowned for their reliability and balanced feel, these instruments represent mid-to-late 20th-century American craftsmanship in professional accessories, offering a timeless aesthetic for collectors and daily users alike.
Set includes one ballpoint pen with gold-tone accents and one polished chrome mechanical pencil
Signature slim cylindrical bodies with twist-action deployment mechanisms
Presented in original black Cross box with red fabric lining and gold-tone label
Box dimensions approximately 7" x 3" x 1"

description:
Vintage Indigenous American-style bolo tie featuring a braided black leather cord and a triangular 925 silver-toned metal slide. The slide is inlaid with horizontal stripes of lapis, malachite, and spiny oyster shell gemstones. The bolo tie tips are silver-toned with some tarnishing, indicating age and use. The slide has a standard tension clasp for securing the cord. Weighs approximately 30.4 grams with tie. Overall condition is gently used with patina and wear consistent with age. Sterling is unmarked.

How Photography Affects Size Perception
Macro (extreme close-up) photography is heavily utilized in jewelry listings, enabling viewers to examine pieces in larger-than-life detail. An accurate understanding of the actual sizes of these pieces cannot be deduced using photos alone. It is important that the bidder takes close note of the measurements and weights to determine actual sizes.
About Gemstone & Metal Testing
Gemstones are tested with a Presidium Gem Tester. Goodwill of the Olympics & Rainier Region is a member of the International Gem Society; however, as we are not certified gemologists, we cannot guarantee the authenticity of any gemstone unless otherwise stated. Gemstone identification information is provided for your reference and consideration in bidding; no guarantee is implied.
Pearls are tested with a check for grittiness to detect nacre irregularities. We are generally unable to specify pearl types and characteristics; they may be cultured, wild, freshwater or saltwater pearls. Coral may be natural or dyed; most of our coral listings include dyed pieces.
Metals including Gold, Silver, and Platinum are tested using an XRF precious metal analyzer, the Niton XL2 by Thermo Scientific, unless explicitly noted otherwise. XRF (X-ray fluorescence) analysis is a non-destructive testing method able to determine an item's elemental composition. Identification of other non-magnetic metals, including brass, bronze, copper, tin, and titanium, rely on our best estimation, and no guarantee is implied; they have not been tested or positively identified unless explicitly noted otherwise. Some jewelry may contain non-precious metals in clasps or findings, causing parts of the piece to respond to a magnet.

description:
Hemingray Glass Company
No. 12 Insulator
Pressed Glass, Aqua Blue, Antique/Vintage
Authentic Hemingray No. 12 glass insulator, a classic piece of American industrial history. Produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, this model was widely used for telephone and telegraph lines during the late 19th and early 20th centuries. It features the signature aqua blue glass and technical design elements common to the era's utility infrastructure.
Embossed "HEMINGRAY NO. 12" on the front skirt
Embossed "PATENT MAY 2 1893" on the reverse side
Sharp drip points along the bottom base edge designed to shed moisture
Translucent aqua blue glass with characteristic manufacturing seed bubbles and swirls
Approximately 3.75 inches tall by 3 inches wide
Condition:
Significant chip and glass loss on the bottom skirt edge as shown in photographs. Minor surface soot and mineral deposits within the interior threads and grooves. Main dome and upper wire grooves remain structurally sound. Original glass color is vibrant with no internal stress cracks.

Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

Specifications:
- Multicolored stone with inscription
- White geode composed of quartz or calcite
- Clear quartz crystal specimen
- Small mineral specimens including agate geodes, chalcedony, and quartz clusters
- Fossils include ammonite and trilobite
- Natural rough edges and matrix present on some pieces

Additional Information:
The specimens vary in size and form a diverse collection of geological and paleontological samples.
